stdout:
usage: howlproof [-h] [--version]
                 {evaluate,validate,profiles,doctor,inspect,explain,report,findings,reproduce,verify-fix,accept,compare,handoff} ...

Independent red-team QA for the Howl ecosystem. HowlProof judges artifacts and
produces evidence; it never repairs the artifact it is judging.

positional arguments:
  {evaluate,validate,profiles,doctor,inspect,explain,report,findings,reproduce,verify-fix,accept,compare,handoff}
    evaluate            challenge an artifact and issue a verdict
    validate            strictly validate an evaluation contract
    profiles            list or show evaluation profiles
    doctor              report which tooling is actually available
    inspect             re-verify a bundle's integrity and print its result
    explain             show why a bundle reached its verdict
    report              print a bundle's report
    findings            list findings from a bundle or the ledger
    reproduce           re-execute a finding's recorded steps
    verify-fix          re-run the evaluator that raised a finding against a
                        changed artifact
    accept              record a decision to live with a finding, with a
                        reason that stays attached
    compare             compare two evaluations of the same artifact
    handoff             write a sibling component's file contract

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
